title: 第393章 神兽使者与姬老的决定第392章 满载而归与石青璇归来
lines: 神兽使者的到来在轩辕城内引发了巨大的关注。
石青璇带青鸾和麒麟幼崽第一次在城内走动时沿街几乎所有人的脚步都停住了。
东山的灵农扛着新收的灵禾从北门进城，在街中间蹲下来对着麒麟幼崽磕了好几个响头。
一个住在东山外围的老灵农跪在田埂上抱着麒麟幼崽哭了——他说他的村子曾经有数百口人，现在只剩不到几十个。
年轻人要么死在边境，要么受不了灵田减产进城做苦力。麒麟幼崽听不懂他那些具体的话语，但它歪着头舔了舔他的手。
老农的眼泪掉在麒麟银青色的鳞甲上，滑下去滴进土里。商秀珣在边上看着这一幕眼圈也红了。
青鸾在城内主道旁的屋檐上蹲了一会儿，以万物有灵诀的频率轻轻震了一下翅膀——它感应到了城中分布在各处的灵田和灵兽体内那些星星点点的微弱生机。
三只灵雀幼崽在青鸾的授意下飞出去分别停在不同人的肩头：
一只停在一个器阁打铁学徒的护肩上，那学徒手里正拎着一柄刚淬完火的铁锤呆了好一阵；
一只停在一个天机阁新手情报分析员的肩膀上，小姑娘正在整理当天的灵脉监测报告，灵雀低头啄了啄她桌上那颗凉透了的灵薯；
最后一只停在了陆承轩的接引台窗口边上。陆承轩看着它，从抽屉里翻出了自己用来垫茶杯用的那碟炒灵谷端到窗口。
“吃吗。”灵雀歪了歪头啄了一粒。
人族议会被紧急召集讨论神兽使者的到来。主战派副议长韩敬忠把石青璇代表使团提交的百兽议事纪要往桌上重重一搁。
“神兽愿意与人族结盟。金仙级以上战力超过二十位。如果我们能在天障破解战中利用这份外援力量填补金仙数量的缺口——”
投降派那边有人举了举手。“神族若质问我们为何与荒古神兽来往，议会如何回答？这是对神族的外部信号，是在释放宣战意图。”
“宣战？”韩敬忠独眼瞪过去，“神族在陨神平原设前哨监控荒古遗域动向的时候可没提前给我们发解释函。他们什么时候在乎过我们的解释？你们怕的不是宣战，是神族不高兴。”
投神派和投魔派在议题下互相交换了极为微妙的眼神。
神兽同盟如果一旦成立，投神派一直口头宣扬的“只有依附神族才能生存”论调会大面积失去底层说服力——神兽是活生生的、战力强大的外援选择，不在神族控制范围内。
投魔派也面临同样的尴尬——魔族一直标榜的“强者才能生存”哲学在神兽同盟的平等互惠框架下自动显得像是一种低层级的小众迷信。
姬老听完各方的争论，将面前的茶杯轻轻放回茶盘上。瓷杯落盘声不重但议事厅安静了。
“麒麟幼崽对人族是什么态度？”
石青璇作为使团代表人站在议事厅一旁，青鸾蹲在她身侧。
她的回答很简单很平静。
“它只是想看看外面的世界。和所有孩子一样。它在百兽禁地有自己的母亲、有白鹿爷爷、有金翅大鹏叔伯。它的族人派它来不是来当供品的，是来交朋友的。
你们把彼此当敌人看待的习惯它没有。它分不清你们谁在主战谁是投降，它分得清的是谁愿意把它当一个客人来尊重。
刚才在街道上它被一个老灵农抱住时没有挣扎。因为那个老农只是需要抱一个值得它信任的温暖东西。”
议事厅沉默了。
投神派和投降派都没再接话。
主战派座位那边不知道是谁用极低的声音骂了一句“给麒麟比给人省心多了”被旁边的人用手肘一推憋了回去。
content_en:
The arrival of the mythical beast messenger caused huge concern in Xuanyuan City.
When Shi Qingxuan took Qingluan and Qilin cubs for the first time in the city, almost everyone along the street stopped.
The spiritual farmer from Dongshan carried the newly harvested Linghe into the city from the north gate. He squatted down in the middle of the street and kowtowed to the unicorn cub several times.
An old spiritual farmer who lived on the outskirts of Dongshan knelt on the field ridge and cried while holding a unicorn cub - he said that his village once had hundreds of people, but now there are less than a few dozen left.
Young people either died on the border, or they couldn't bear the reduction in production in Lingtian and went to work as coolies in the city. The unicorn cub couldn't understand his specific words, but it tilted its head and licked his hand.
The old farmer's tears fell on Qilin's silver-green scales, sliding down and dripping into the soil. Shang Xiuxun's eyes were red as he watched this scene from the side.
Qingluan squatted on the eaves next to the main road in the city for a while, and gently flapped its wings with the frequency of the animist secret - it sensed the spiritual fields scattered throughout the city and the faint vitality of the spiritual beasts.
Under Qingluan's instruction, the three sparrow cubs flew out and landed on the shoulders of different people:
One stopped on the shoulder of a blacksmith apprentice from Qi Pavilion. The apprentice was holding a hammer that had just been tempered and stayed there for a long time;
One stopped on the shoulder of a novice intelligence analyst from Tianji Pavilion. The little girl was sorting out the spiritual pulse monitoring report for the day. The sparrow lowered its head and pecked the cold spiritual potato on her table;
The last one stopped at the window of Lu Chengxuan's reception desk. Lu Chengxuan looked at it, took out the plate of fried Linggu he used to place his tea cup from the drawer, and brought it to the window.
"Eat it?" The sparrow tilted its head and pecked one.
The human race parliament was urgently summoned to discuss the arrival of the divine beast messenger. Han Jingzhong, the deputy speaker of the main war faction, placed the minutes of the meeting of beasts submitted by Shi Qingxuan on behalf of the mission on the table.
"The divine beasts are willing to form an alliance with the human race. There are more than twenty golden immortals with combat power above the level. If we can use this foreign aid to fill the gap in the number of golden immortals in the battle to crack the sky barrier -"
Someone from the capitulation faction raised their hands. "If the Protoss asks us why we have contact with the ancient beasts, how will the Council respond? This is an external signal to the Protoss, and it is releasing the intention to declare war."
"Declaration of war?" Han Jingzhong glared with one eye, "When the Gods set up outposts in the Meteor God Plain to monitor the movements of the ancient ruins, they did not send us an explanation letter in advance. When did they care about our explanation? What you are afraid of is not the declaration of war, but the Gods being unhappy."
The God-casting sect and the Demon-casting sect exchanged very subtle glances with each other under the topic.
If the mythical beast alliance is established, the argument that "only by relying on the gods can survive" that the God-seeking faction has been preaching will lose its underlying persuasion on a large scale - the mythical beasts are living, powerful foreign aid options and are not within the control of the gods.
The Demon Casting Sect also faces the same embarrassment - the philosophy of "only the strong survive" that the Demon Clan has always flaunted automatically appears to be a low-level niche superstition under the framework of equality and reciprocity of the Divine Beast Alliance.
After listening to the arguments of all parties, Mr. Ji gently placed the tea cup in front of him back on the tea tray. The sound of porcelain cups falling onto the plate was not loud, but the meeting hall was quiet.
"What is the attitude of the unicorn cub towards the human race?"
Shi Qingxuan stood beside the meeting hall as the representative of the mission, and Qingluan squatted beside her.
Her answer was simple and calm.
"It just wants to see the outside world. Like all children. It has its own mother, Grandpa White Deer, and Uncle Golden-winged Dapeng in the Forbidden Land of All Beasts. Its tribe did not send it here as an offering, but to make friends.
It doesn't have the habit of treating each other as enemies. It cannot tell which of you is fighting and who is surrendering. What it can tell is who is willing to respect it as a guest.
Just now it didn't struggle when it was hugged by an old spiritual farmer on the street. Because the old farmer just needs to hold something warm and worthy of his trust. "
The chamber fell silent.
Neither the surrender faction nor the capitulation faction answered the call.
Someone on the other side of the main combatant's seat cursed in a very low voice, "It's much easier to give to Qilin than to others." The person next to him pushed him back with his elbow.
title_en: Chapter 393 The Decision of the Divine Beast Messenger and Mr. Ji Chapter 392 Returning with a Full Load and Return of Shi Qingxuan
